top_signals.title: China Stock Bull Sees Up to 15% Upside on Earnings, Valuation
top_signals.summary: The MSCI China Index has 10% to 15% upside as earnings grow and low valuations bolster the country’s appeal as an alternative to global markets, according to UBS Group AG.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Slide as Global Glut Fears Eclipse Hormuz Attacks
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices extended a decline that began earlier this month, as reports about a global glut multiplied, suggesting there was no supply squeeze at all, despite continuing attacks on vessels in the Persian Gulf and the Yemeni Houthis’ strikes on Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $91.70 per barrel, and West Texas Intermediate was trading at $85.03 per barrel, both down from Monday’s close.
